records.text: Kanye West lost his Adidas and Gap contracts after the 2022 post.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The entire world condemned Kanye West. ... He lost his Adidas contract. He lost his Gap contract.

verification.notes: Adidas terminated its Ye partnership on October 25, 2022, after the October post. Gap says it had already ended the Yeezy Gap partnership in September, before that post, although it removed remaining products after Ye's later remarks.

sources.title: Adidas terminates partnership with Ye immediately
sources.relevance: Primary company statement confirms Adidas ended the partnership October 25, 2022.

sources.title: Statement on Yeezy Partnership — Gap
sources.relevance: Primary company statement says Gap had already ended the partnership in September, before the October post, while later removing products.

records.text: According to Owens, Kanye West told her he was finally free in a phone call within hours of Adidas announcing it was ending its deal with him.
records.speaker: Kanye West

appearances.snippet: And when I spoke to him on the phone and I am talking, I spoke to him within hours of that public announcement of Adidas making that public announcement. ... He said, I'm finally free. ... I thought he was going to be upset. And he said, I'm finally free.

conveyance.original_source: Private phone call recalled by Candace Owens

records.text: I saw it up close. And even I thought Ye (Kanye West) was crazy or like having—was being hysterical—when he turned around to me in my house and he said—when all that was going down and Adidas was canceling him, Gap was canceling him— he was like, "Are you an op, too?"
